en:
Set up and assign chants for our club.
Choose the chant you want to set.

Set up and assign chants for the
Japan National Team.
Choose the chant you want to set.

Which situation is the chant for?
Choose from four situations.

Supporters sing this freely, whatever
the state of the match. A tune with
broad appeal would work best.

Sung when the match is going badly, to
encourage the players. A stirring tune
would suit it well.

Sung during matches to lift spirits.
Used when you want to turn the tide, so
the club's main theme would be ideal.

Sung when you hold the momentum.
A cheerful tune to keep up the pressure
would be a good choice, I think.

Choose which chant to sing. Pick from
the built-in tunes or your save data.

Choose from the built-in
tunes or the tunes in
a save file?

Pick a tune from the list. Load it in
the Chant Editor to preview it.

Select the VMU holding the chant
you want to assign.

Which chant should be assigned?
Please select a file.

No chant save file
was found.

Chant loaded successfully.
This tune will be assigned.
Failed to load the chant.
Returned from the load screen.

Let's give the chant you're
making a title.

Go to the score to compose a tune.
Press @Y/X Button@ to play, again to stop.
Pick vowels on screen with @R/a@@Y/i@@G/u@@O/e@@B/o@.

Let's change the score layout.
Pick 3 or 4 beats per section,
whichever is easier to read.

You can change the tune's speed.
It's usually set to speed "5".

I'll load tunes I've prepared and chant
data saved on the VMU. You can listen
to them and edit them, too.

Save your current chant to the VMU.
Saving is needed once before it can be
assigned to a chant in a match.

Quit making chants and go back to the
Supporters' Club. Anything unsaved will
be lost, so take care.

Press @P/A Button@ where you want a note.
Hold @P/A Button@ + right to extend it.
Press @B/B Button@ to finish composing.

On a note, like now, you can also
erase it with @B/B Button@.

Let's place the rhythm sounds.
At the same spot, hold @R/A Button@ to
change the instrument.

Of the vowels @R/a@@Y/i@@G/u@@O/e@@B/o@,
I'm picking "@R/a@".

Of the vowels @R/a@@Y/i@@G/u@@O/e@@B/o@,
I'm picking "@Y/i@".

Of the vowels @R/a@@Y/i@@G/u@@O/e@@B/o@,
I'm picking "@G/u@".

Of the vowels @R/a@@Y/i@@G/u@@O/e@@B/o@,
I'm picking "@O/e@".

Of the vowels @R/a@@Y/i@@G/u@@O/e@@B/o@,
I'm picking "@B/o@".

Triplets for advanced users.
After choosing this, select part of the
score to use triplets. Press @B/B@ to end.

Choose this to copy a selected section
and paste it. Handy when you want to
repeat something.

Now hold @R/A Button@ and press the D-pad
left or right to widen the section you
want to copy.

Here, move left or right to grab the
@B/"REPEAT"@ and @O/"END"@ markers.

You can set where the tune returns to
after one loop. Grab it with @R/A Button@,
then move it with the left/right keys.

You can change the end of the tune.
Grab it with @R/A Button@ and
move it left or right.

Pick from the tunes I made,
or from a save file?

Choose a tune from the list. You can
use it as a base to change and fix up.

Pick the VMU with the chant you
want to load.

Which chant do you want to load?
Pick a file.

I couldn't find a chant
save file.

The chant loaded fine.
I'll show it on the score.
Oops, the chant failed to load.

I'll mark off part of the score for
triplets. It's for music buffs.
Press @B/B Button@ to finish this.

Decide where the tune restarts from
after it loops round.
Set it with @R/A Button@.

Decide where the tune ends.
Set it with @R/A Button@.
